firm: the one firm the tie-out reads (49 Financial), its own gold prefix only

served_rule.END: data/assets/scripts/gold/irpt_reporting/account_return_daily.py lines 1383-1406 (chain of sub-periods; with no intervening custodian valuation it is the endpoint form (V_t - F_t) / V_(t-1) - 1 at line 1400) and the module docstring lines 28-45; the flow F_t is summed over the custodian partition days after t-1 up to t; the PRD's C-METHOD / C-FLOWTIME name the same rule
served_rule.windows: infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/reporting-publish/publisher.py lines 275-310: a window is the geometric link of total_return_daily over the days dated after its anchor up to as_of; not spanned if the first data date is after the anchor; a null-return day inside the window breaks it (no figure). YTD, QTD, 1Y, 3Y and SI are served; MTD is NOT a served window: here MTD uses the same rule with the anchor at the prior month end, and ITD is the served SI rule

restatement.definition: reused, not re-implemented: the three one-day formulas of org/missions/D9/IRPT/IRPT_DASHBD/deliverables/0.9.0_WK_IRPT_DASHBD~121/y1_place.py relink, lines 44-52 (START v1/(v0+f)-1; MID (v1-f/2)/(v0+f/2)-1; END (v1-f)/v0-1), the definition cited in TIMING_CLASSES_PROPOSAL.json definitions_cited.admitted_timings. Applied per served day instead of chained over a segment; v0 is the previous served row's market_value_eod of the same account, f the served external_flow of the day
restatement.difference_from_121: 121 skips a day whose served return is null before choosing the prior day; here the prior value is the previous served row whether or not its return is null, and a null-return day is not restated (left null)

end_reproduces.not_equal_explained_by: all not_equal days carry carried_days 2 and a flow: a custodian valuation on the skipped day sits inside the window and the served END chains through it (account_return_daily.py lines 1383-1406); a day-pair restatement cannot see that valuation. no_prior_value is NOT explained
end_reproduces.share_not_reproduced: 19 of 2596311 served-return days (about 7 in a million), under the 1 in 100 stop line
end_reproduces.price_return_fallback_note: no served row carries return_basis HOLDINGS_INCOME_FALLBACK (return_basis is TWR or NOT_MEASURABLE only; account_return_daily.py line 164 'NEVER EMITTED'), so the named class is empty; nothing to leave as served
end_reproduces.left_as_served: the not_equal days, the no_prior_value days and days where the START denominator is zero are left as served under START and MID (not differing); null-return days stay null

differing_precision: the served file is float64; a day differs when the absolute difference exceeds 1e-12 of a return (above float64 round-off of a ratio of two sums); days differing only below that floor are counted in differing_strictly_above_zero
bands_edges: absolute difference: under_1bp is below 1 basis point; from_1_to_10bp is 1 to 10 inclusive; over_10bp is above 10
flow_day_definition: flow_days: restated account-days (served return present, END reproduced) whose served external_flow is nonzero; a day with no flow has the same return under all three conventions and is not a differing day
largest_band_note_daily: under_1bp holds the most differing days both ways; over_10bp holds the fewest, and END-to-START has more over_10bp days than END-to-MID
private_table: the private evidence folder for worker ~128 under IRPT_DASHBD (account_day_table.parquet, README.txt), outside the repo
limits: A day-pair restatement from the served row: it does not see an intervening custodian valuation on a skipped day, so 17 served-return days that chain through one are not reproduced and are left as served.
For a day with carried_days 2 the served flow is the two-day sum and START/MID treat it as one day's flow: sizes on those days (a few thousand rows in the copy) are an approximation.

Windows follow the publisher's rule for a window carried (spanned and no null-return day inside it); accounts that break or are not spanned are not counted in the window and are listed under windows.not_carried. Under START and MID a window is the chain of the restated days and a not-restated day keeps its served return.
The copy begins at the first served partition; ITD is anchored at each account's first served row, so for an account that was already in the book then it is since the start of the copy.
The served flag of a restated day (day_quality, guard_state) is read as served; how the guard's flags would move under START or MID is DB-b-160's question and is not answered here.
The guard's thresholds were not re-run; no restated day was re-graded.

the_39.statement: 39 of the 90 two-sided segments close under NO timing (31 of the accrual class, 8 unclassed); nothing in this record changes them, and a change of flow convention would not close the tie-out.
